municipalities.note: Production cluster — Ellevio holds line concession for 130 kV lines connecting wind power to the Torpberget transmission substation. No area concession in this subarea.

interconnection_points.note: Transmission substation; Ellevio has one interconnection point to Svenska Kraftnät.

production_installed.note: Wind production connected via radial 130 kV lines to the Torpberget transmission substation.

narrative_note: Production cluster in Ljusdal municipality. Network connects wind production via radial 130 kV lines to the Torpberget transmission substation; Ellevio holds line concession for these lines.
